CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content; A is absent.

COD.rationale: C and D are explicit for specific referents/times, but no organization/presentation evidence is explicitly bound to the same referent/attribute/time; binding is therefore ambiguous.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the identified contents' presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers with named attributes (e.g., red/blue) and coordinate values are present.

D.rationale: Origins/metadata (e.g., copied_prior_record, command_estimate, history_estimate) separately attribute status/source to identified contents.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: Text describes how data are presented/organized (grid orientation and that current/candidate peaks follow).
